description:
Free. Finds the USDOT number for an operating-authority docket number
(MC, MX or FF), so a broker holding the MC number from a rate
confirmation can reach the other tools, which take a USDOT number.

mc_number may be written "MC123456", "MC-123456", "mc 123456" or just
"123456" (a bare number is taken as MC); zero-padding is ignored, because
FMCSA's own files disagree on it. authority_holder_usdot_number is the
carrier FMCSA's authority records tie the docket to, and there is never
more than one. usdot_numbers lists every carrier that lists the docket
(FMCSA's census lists about 26,000 dockets under a second carrier too, so
a docket can legitimately appear under two), the holder first. docket_status
and status_source say how current that is: "motus" is live, "legacy_li" is
FMCSA's archive as of 2026-05-14, "census" is the census file's code.
Returns only identifiers and a status, no names or addresses. An unknown
docket is a not_found error; an unreadable one is invalid_arguments.
Never billed.
name: find_carrier_by_mc
